notes: Adds native macOS Share and standalone Print Screen/F13 custom shortcuts. Capture setup now offers Command-Shift-9 or one custom shortcut; reserved shortcuts must be freed manually. Keeps launch at login. Includes compact tool hints. Apple silicon development version; not notarized.

Fixes size controls for Text and Pixelate at small panel sizes and rapid clicks. The former 80% panel size is now 100%. Adds a full-width centered size field, wider bold minus/plus buttons, larger action labels and larger hints. Apple silicon development version; not notarized.
